about: Version history of every public legal page, newest first. The legal pages show the latest date as 'Last updated' and the one before it as 'Previously updated', with this list as the change history. Add an entry at the top whenever a page's wording changes; the page's Markdown carries no date of its own. See content/legal/README.md.

terms-and-conditions.md.changes: Our website and email addresses moved to the aaggregates.store domain.
Section 6 now covers materials cut or made to your specification, such as roof sheets cut to length and steel cut and bent, which can't be returned or refunded once cut.
Section 2 sets out the units each product is sold in, "price on request" products, and trade discounts by product type; section 4 describes the payment methods generally.
